original_question: List the CRs whose affected clauses resolve to actual sections of spec 38.331 (clause-to-section matching).
original_query: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'})-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'}) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub2:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'}) WHERE hub2.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> '' UNWIND split(cr.clausesAffected, ',') AS clause WITH cr, rk, trim(clause) AS clause MATCH (s:Section {sectionNumber: clause})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, clause, s.sectionId ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber, clause, s.sectionId LIMIT 10

Korean_original: clausesAffected로 실제 Section과 매칭되는 CR 목록은?
reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
  AND (
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '[0-9]+|[A-Z]' AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?:^|[,;\\n&]|\\band\\b)\\s*(?:(?i:sub-?clauses?|clauses?|sections?|annex(?:es)?)\\s+)?\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E\\.?\\s*(?:\\([^)]*\\)\\s*)?(?:$|[,;\\n&]|\\band\\b).*'))
    OR
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '([0-9].*|[A-Z]\\..*)' AND NOT s.sectionNumber =~ '[0-9]+'
      AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/#:~\\-])\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E(?![A-Za-z0-9_]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*'))
    OR
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9-]+' AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?:^|[,;\\n&])\\s*(?:[0-9][A-Za-z0-9.]*\\s*[–\\-:(/]\\s*)?\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E\\s*\\)?\\s*(?:$|[,;\\n&]).*'))
  )
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
ORDER BY tdocNumber

field_resolution_rules.strong_literal_identifier: Search the full literal field for the exact quoted actual Section identifier at complete boundaries; no case folding, punctuation deletion, prefix-parent fallback or guessed missing delimiters.
field_resolution_rules.weak_top_level_and_Annex: A single integer or Annex letter must occupy a comma/semicolon/newline/ampersand/and-separated item, optionally preceded by clause/section/Annex and followed by final period or parenthesis qualifier.
field_resolution_rules.ASN_named_identifier: Exact named Section must be the whole list item, or the terminal explicit name following a numeric identifier and dash/colon/parenthesis/slash. A name inside unrelated explanatory title prose is not enough.
field_resolution_rules.suffix: Retain exact suffixes including5.3.5.13b1; placeholders such as5.5.4.XX cannot resolve to5.5.4.
field_resolution_rules.range_or_shorthand: Only explicitly complete independent identifiers are witnesses. Do not expand a shorthand tail or range into unrecorded Section identifiers.
field_resolution_rules.order: No requested order; ORDERBY is reproducible display only.
field_resolution_rules.multiplicity: Any number of matching clauses/Section rows/source observations yields one tdocNumber. Do not collapse distinct Tdocs sharing CRnumber/revision/spec.
